title: Heat Equation driven by mixed local-nonlocal operators with non-regular space-dependent coefficients
summary: In this paper, we study the Cauchy problem for a heat equation governed by a mixed local--nonlocal diffusion operator with spatially dependent coefficients. For bounded measurable coefficients satisfying uniform positivity conditions and initial data in $H^1(\mathbb R^d)$, we first establish existence and uniqueness of weak solutions in the natural energy space and derive an a priori energy estimate.
